overview: After 90 spicy teacher, independent woman Gu Xiaomeng attaches importance to career, the pursuit of self-worth, operating a beautiful "small indeed lucky" life, but was suddenly "both parents" disrupted, marriage and career into a deadlock. When the unreliable brother, the strong mother, the parent-in-law, the rebellious transfer student, Once missed the campus lovers, and accidentally pregnant baby to crush the avalanche of Gu Xiaomeng's life, the only ally husband Lv Xiang, but also because of unemployment, re-entrepreneurship, and even because of the verge of derailment, from "God assists" to "pig teammates." Gu Xiaomeng, a clever teacher who always wins against her students, encounters Waterloo in her marriage, so she rethinks the meaning of marriage and family, completes self-transformation and reconciliation with her mother, and finally grows into a real all-conquering but rigid-flexible Big Lady.
title: Family

overview: After her sister's tragic death, Yu Qinghuan was adopted by her brother-in-law, Jiang Mohan, a powerful warlord, and was raised to become the owner of a pleasure house. To her shock, the man she admired and respected was the very one she wished to kill—the murderer of her sister. Jiang Mohan believed he could remain heartless, but he ultimately fell for her. As the fog clears, their twisted love and fated bond emerge amidst hatred. Will the misunderstandings and pain between them become barriers or ties that bind? Play
title: No One But You

overview: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge puts a playful competition spin on the bears of Alaska's Katmai National Park as they bulk up for winter hibernation. Over 150 days, the bears battle the elements - and each other - using brains and brawn to consume three million calories and gain up to 200 pounds in Nature's real-life survival show. Unbeknownst to the bears, their progress is being tracked and ranked for a television audience with narration that combines fascinating facts about bear behavior with clever color commentary.
title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge

overview: The Vietnam War is one of the most controversial wars in United States history, and as battles were beamed into the nation's living rooms night after night, widespread protests led to a fundamental shift in America's national identity. Hundreds of film crews captured the action as it unfolded on the battlefield and now, through meticulous journalism, Vietnam: The War That Changed America tracks down the soldiers and civilians on all sides who lived through the war, bringing them together, often for the first time in almost half a century. Each episode features powerful reunions and the emotional stories told by those who faced agonizing life or death situations and impossible moral decisions. Across six episodes a picture also builds of the profound changes to America itself, and a very different country that emerged out of the war.
title: Vietnam: The War That Changed America

overview: A tragic human comedy drama about the village head who took the lead in neutering Onghwa Village's Cassanova dog, Baek-goo, and ends up in the same situation as the dog when he suddenly undergo a vasectomy.
title: The Pork Cutlets

overview: Sketch show with famous German comedian Anke Engelke.
title: Ladykracher

overview: Facing her own divorce, seasoned divorce lawyer Cha Eun Kyung has grown jaded with the concept of Justice, instead opting for the path with the most monetary gain. This changes after she begins working with passionate rookie lawyer Han Yoo Ri, who believes in helping people regardless of the money.
title: Good Partner

overview: Tony, in his 50s, drives a black cab, doing the night shift in the city. He used to be a popular and respected teacher but after losing his job, his confidence plummeted, his marriage collapsed, and he's become increasingly isolated. Now his only lifelines are cafe-worker Rosa, whom he forms a growing attachment to, and a radio DJ called Lawrence whom he spends his nights listening to. One night Tony plucks up the courage and rings NightTalk to speak to Lawrence, and soon becomes a ‘friend of the show'. For the first time in years, he feels listened to. But as time passes, his developing bond with the late-night DJ begins to turn into an unhealthy obsession as he starts interpreting Lawrence's ‘world view' in dangerous ways that have devastating impacts on Tony's life. One night, by chance, Lawrence gets into Tony's cab. The initial excitement at meeting takes a turn when Tony realises this DJ isn't the man he purports to be. Lawrence is a fake and Tony feels betrayed. The Night Caller is a claustrophobic tale about the power of influence those with the loudest voice have over the most vulnerable people.
title: The Night Caller

overview: Paul Whitehouse celebrates sketch shows in a new four-part series. Personally curated and narrated by Paul, the series takes viewers on a journey through his favourite British sketch shows of the past 60 years, with each episode broadly covering a decade in sketch show history, from iconic shows such as The Two Ronnies, to The Catherine Tate Show which have mirrored the story of modern Britain.
title: Paul Whitehouse's Sketch Show Years

overview: General Election results from a 360-degree immersive studio normally used by Sky Sports shows like Monday Night Football.
title: The Battle for Number 10

overview: WWII. A detachment of underground partisans under the leadership of commander Shmakov is hiding out in a forest near the front lines. They are joined by a reconnaissance group led by Major Semin from State Security. The day to day life of the partisans is extremely tense, as they risk their lives fighting the enemy and encounter conflicts within their own group. Hoping to enhance his career, Semin contacts Shimmel, a highly place German spy, in an attempt to recruit him for the Soviet side. During the encounter, Semin is given false information about chemical bombs supposedly developed by the Germans. Semin immediately informs central command, sure that he will be rewarded for his important discovery. However, central command decides that the tip needs to be confirmed and sends reconnaissance officer Lida Eisenschmidt to get close to Shimmel and get to the bottom of the chemical weapons story. Kurt Shimmel and Lida Eisenschmidt are well matched adversaries. They are both professionals and brave opportunists, able to control themselves in the most extreme conditions. Both are lonely, surrounded by colleagues who cannot appreciate their skill or understand their dance with death. Kurt and Lida are predators - born of war - who have lost all traces of their humanity. But perhaps that is the essence of human nature.
title: Человек войны

overview: Based on the story "Actress" by Ekaterina Markova. In a famous Moscow drama theater, mysterious murders occur one after another. The main director of the troupe, Alena Pozdnyakova, becomes the only person who can determine the motives, explain the goals and reveal the relationship of these crimes. The entire theatrical environment of Alena is involved in the whirlpool of events, and she herself barely escapes cruel reprisals. Now the girl is forced to be the main participant in this tragic "theatrical detective story"...
title: Нежное чудовище

overview: Adult life for simple village guy Sasha Vanyukin starts with murder. However, the draw of a beautiful life in the big city turned out to be stronger than any crisis of conscience and the murder case remained unclosed. Vanyukin's business started with petty theft and unlawful trading of rare icons and, in the upheaval of the early 90's, this is what brought him success and made him the owner of a major bank. But, in life you pay for your mistakes, and Vanyukin has a long list of sins. He doesn't suspect that the long forgotten murder will become a curse for him, his family and his children...
title: Дети Ванюхина

overview: Mikhail left to serve in the army, and Lida remained waiting for him in his hometown. After the first skirmish with the "grandfathers" - a trial and a sentence for manslaughter. Having been released, Mikhail returns home, where everything has become different - life in the city is determined by the local oligarch, who is served by both Mikhail's half-brother and Lida, who performs "special functions." Mikhail finds his place in this life, but soon he has a conflict with the son of the oligarch - an influential and presumptuous businessman who decides to eliminate Mikhail. Only those who love can save him. At the same time, they are ready to pay the highest price for their love...
title: Плата за любовь

overview: A drama chronicling the lives of twentysomethings in the hip L.A. neighborhood of Silverlake.
title: Sex, Love & Secrets

overview: Airport resembles a small country, but native part of it is smaller then the foreigners part. It's hard to tell the genre of series as one can find elements of comedy, drama and melodrama in it. The main part of the Airoport is people. Employees of different services with their problems, concerns and happiness.
title: Аэропорт

overview: On par with previous shows featuring The Great War and World War II in real-time, week by week, the third documentary focuses on Korean war. It is covered week by week, following the war in real-time.
title: The Korean War

overview: "Money Talk$" takes viewers inside the world of sports betting, a world dominated by Steve Stevens. As owner of VIP Sports, a handicapping business in Las Vegas, Stevens has a stable of agents that keep the phone lines running 24/7. But Stevens himself remains the king, the top closer, the highest earner. He knows the games, he's got access to information and he delivers, for the gamblers who place a hundred dollars on a game to the whales who routinely wager six-figure bets. Stevens consults with the biggest sports betters in the world, including his good friend, the boxer Floyd "Money" Mayweather, who recently placed a million dollar bet on a college football game.
title: Money Talks

overview: This is the romantic and fun story of Lola, a modern Cinderella, rebellious and optimistic, who does not sit back and wait for a fairy godmother to solve her problems with her wand, but goes out into the world to find happiness on her own. Lola, érase una vez, is a beautiful story for young people and their families, a modern fairy tale, but full of music, joy, emotion, optimism and, above all, love.
title: Lola, érase una vez

overview: Breaking Amish: Brave New World is an American reality television series on TLC. The series is a spin-off of Breaking Amish and encompasses the original cast from season one as they relocate and reside in Pinecraft - a small neighborhood located within Sarasota, Florida where there is a community of ex-Amish and Amish. It chronicles the lives of the cast as they endure the realities of living in new surroundings and face new situations involving work, friendship, romance, and lifestyle. It also includes the drama that develops between cast members as they undergo various experiences.
title: Breaking Amish: Brave New World

overview: Sofia lives a life of success. She falls in love with her personal driver Salvador and they struggle to keep their relationship together.
title: Hasta el Fin del Mundo Te Amare
Raue Welten - Wilde Schönheiten - Die Balkanhalbinsel

overview: Inspired by the life of a real covert intelligence officer who is still active in the field today, the series follows a highly skilled privately contracted team of operatives as they recover hostages across the globe from some of the most exotic and equally dangerous locations on the planet.
title: Snatchback

overview: Van Helsing is a contemporary take on the monster hunter Dr. Abraham Van Helsing, who uses his uniquely inquisitive mind working alongside his ex, relentless FBI special agent Mina Harker, to solve New York City's most harrowing cases.
title: Van Helsing
Yao Wo Cheng Feng Du Shan Hai

overview: The West Coast Hustle chronicles Chanel's life, capturing all its exciting and memorable moments. Fans get an intimate look at her journey as she navigates the challenges of her new favorite full-time gig - motherhood - while simultaneously pursuing her music career. Juggling a personal life with her boyfriend Dom, a high-pressure career and maintaining friendships — Chanel is determined to hustle and have it all!
title: The West Coast Hustle

overview: "Hot Ones" spin-off series where guests have two choices: Tell the truth, or suffer the wrath of the Last Dab. Whoever eats the most wings, loses.
title: Hot Ones Versus

overview: A look back at classic hidden camera pranks along with the people originally involved.
title: Greatest Ever Wind Ups

overview: This single-camera comedy follows Zach Stone, a fresh out of high school teenager who opts to pursue a life of fame and stardom instead of attending college. He hires a camera crew to film him throughout his daily life as a part of his quest to become an overnight celebrity – even though he possesses no real talent. From Zach's attempts to become a celebrity chef or a ring-tone recording artist to purposefully going missing, he'll try any avenue to get noticed and stop at nothing until he reaches fame. Chaos, awkwardness and embarrassment ensue in this clever and timely series that serves as a comedic send-up of today's current culture of instant celebrity.
title: Zach Stone is Gonna Be Famous

overview: Ghosts centres around young couple Emma and Felix, who inherit an old mansion and decide to turn it into a hotel. After a near-death accident Emma suddenly starts to see ghosts. These bizarre and chaotic roommates, including characters such as the Neanderthal Urs, the Roman legionnaire Claudius, the Countess Adelheid, the feminist maid Griet, the insurance salesman Joachim, the teacher Svenni and the love-hungry poet Friedrich Dorn come from different eras and cause quite a stir in the couple's lives.
title: Ghosts

overview: When his failure to intervene in a violent confrontation in a playground brings his identity crisis to a head, John ups and moves his family to the rural idyll of Coldwater, as far away from London as possible. Upon arrival, John is quickly befriended by next-door neighbour Tommy, a charming, confident man, devoted husband to the local vicar Rebecca. He is a man of faith, a pillar of the community and self-appointed leader of the village's all-male book group. John is both impressed and slightly fascinated by Tommy. His wife Fiona despises him. As a successful former chef hoping to launch a new venture in Coldwater, Fiona sees the move as an opportunity to leave the past behind them. To not only re-build their lives as a family but re-ignite the long-lost spark in their fading marriage. When her husband's relationship with their enigmatic new neighbour becomes increasingly intense, Fiona's suspicions are aroused. She is unconvinced Tommy is all he seems to be. But John remains blissfully unaware that Tommy is harbouring horrifying secrets, and it's only after a series of unsettling incidents start to occur that John begins to wonder who the real Tommy actually is.
title: Coldwater

overview: Secrets of the Supermarket Buyers will see Denise meet with current and former buyers from Britain's biggest supermarket chains to find out just how they decide what to sell to the nation's consumers. From the discount disruptors to the premium grocers, the series will lift the lid on the tactics used by behind-the-scenes buyers to get popular items into stores and, ultimately, into shoppers' trolleys. How do they predict demand and what the next big trends will be?
title: Secrets of the Supermarket Buyers

overview: Joel C. Rosenberg is a respected geo-political expert on the Middle East. Each week, he offers a close-up view of current events and issues in this volatile region, bringing important insights and biblical perspective.
title: The Rosenberg Report

overview: A film about the life of a group of first-year students, future television journalists. Each of the young heroes of the film tries in their own way to gain authority among friends and teachers, to establish themselves in the student body and profession.
title: Будем знакомы!

overview: How much will you sacrifice for the truth? And must the truth emerge at all costs? New journalistic crime series with Mille Dinesen in the lead role focuses on investigative journalism and what the investigative journalists have to go through as democracy's watchdogs.
title: Graverne

overview: Lucrecia's murder begins a journey to the roots of hatred in this gripping tale with unseen footage.
title: Lucrecia: un crimen de odio

overview: By the age of 30, ex-stripper Mara acutely feels a crisis of self-realization. To prove to everyone around her that she can do more than just strip for money, the girl decides to go into business and persuades her former sponsor Yurich to let her manage a beauty salon. Mara becomes the manager, not of a beauty salon, but of a dilapidated car wash on the outskirts of the city. Will a former stripper be able to master a new social role and make a not-so-successful business profitable?
title: Мокрые майки

overview: A four-part docuseries chronicling one of the longest cold cases in Spanish history: the 1995 kidnapping of businessman Publio Cordon.
title: Publio: El secuestro sin fin

overview: In the 90s, Dino worked for tough gangster Montana and was Moscow's most ruthless debt collector. Now he lives as a hermit in the province. But events unfold in such a way that Dino returns to the capital and starts his old job in order to pay off his debt from the past, which has tormented him all these years and return the woman of his dreams. During Dino's adventures, he will have to face both modern realities and the relict 90s, which have adapted somewhere, withered somewhere, but still deeply rooted in our reality. And Dino, as a guide between two worlds, will once again have to undergo a test of his life principles.
title: Дино

overview: In the town of Dillon, Texas, football is life, and no one knows that better than new head Coach Eric Taylor. Pressure mounts as the Dillon Panthers led by star quarterback Jason Street, enter pre-season surrounded by a swirl of press, recruiters and State Championship sized expectations. Backup quarterback Matt Saracen prepares to ride the bench in the shadow of Jason Street, as running back Tim Riggins struggles with a serious vice. As the season opener grows near, the town of Dillon is focused on what they believe to be most important, winning.
title: Friday Night Lights

overview: "Comedy Nights Bachao" is an Indian comedy television series, which premiered on 5 September 2015 on Colors TV. The series is scheduled to air on Saturday nights. The series is stated to be a reality show with a format similar to Comedy Circus with many of the same production team,and will be produced by Optimystix Entertainment. Shruti Seth, Sara Khan, Anita Hassanandani Reddy will be some of the actors in the series. Comedy Nights Bachao 's first guest appearance is Mika Singh, Sohail Khan, Salman Khan, Sooraj Pancholi, Athiya Shetty. Sara Khan was replaced by Adaa Khan in the second episode.
title: Comedy Nights Bachao

overview: The primitive era of human history can hardly be called a paradise like the biblical Eden. Instead of a quiet life, two tribes living along the banks of one wide river face severe danger every day. The Chief's tribe is losing ground due to the weakness and inexperience of their leader, who wants to be a friend to everyone. But the tribe of "morons" led by the Leader is at the peak of its strength and lives in prosperity. Therefore, one of the Leader's hunters runs away to his competitors, and the Leader's people joyfully accept him. But few of the savages understand what is really happening on the other side.
title: жЫЫЫзнь

overview: Franck and his longtime friends enjoy spending their weekends hunting together, but one Sunday, they come across another group of hunters who start targeting them without explanation. When one of their party is shot, Franck's friends strike back, sending an attacker to the ground. Barely managing to escape, the four friends keep the event a secret. Franck tries to go back to his life as usual alongside his wife Krystel, but in the next few days, he starts to feel like he and his friends are being watched, or worse, tracked by hunters who are now hell-bent on revenge.
title: Traqués

overview: To find her way home, Liang Hong must collect all five glass beads, but she accidentally "messes with" five men. Liang Hong has been repeatedly "forced to marry", which not only causes her to get into scandals but also makes her a player from a person who's never been in a relationship before. Then she becomes a female version of "Wei Xiaobao", who's got seven wives, in Jiankang City. She was going to run away after the scam, but she's caught up in a conspiracy...
title: Gossip Princess

overview: Get ready for a heartwarming and surprise-filled musical journey with Serenata de las Estrellas. Hosted by Julissa Bermudez, some of the biggest names in Latin music surprise deserving members of the community with once-in-a-lifetime concerts in unexpected locations. From church fundraisers to taquerias, no place is off-limits for these pop-up performances, with real people, real stars, and real surprises.
title: Serenata De Las Estrellas

overview: The Au Pair follows a woman who seems to have it all—a successful husband, adorable stepchildren, a thriving business and a gorgeous home. When her diabetic father moves in next door and she begins to experience marital issues, however, she reluctantly agrees to hire an au pair. A beguiling young French woman takes the job and causes an unsettling shift in the household. As instincts and suspicions arise, hidden agendas are hinted at and long-concealed truths are unveiled.
title: The Au Pair

overview: Prison Chronicles takes you inside some of the world's most notorious prisons. Every episode delves into the unique history of a specific prison, showcasing its wildest practices, infamous inmates, harrowing events, and ingenious escapes. Spanning 1,000 years, the series covers legendary institutions from the historic Tower of London to today's high-tech ADX, where El Chapo is currently held. Through interviews with journalists, former correctional officers, and previously incarcerated individuals, the series offers an authentic glimpse into the inner workings of these prisons.
title: Prison Chronicles

overview: Plunge into a journey across atypical cemeteries and discover the colossal beauty of cars' graveyards, supertankers, trains, military vehicles and abandoned ruins around the world. Some of these testimonies of our industrial civilization are classified in the World Heritage, others are under threat of reversal or erasure. This series takes us to meet collectors, biologists, and environmentalists who defend the new ecosystems that have taken over these wrecks. A breathtaking and patrimonial voyage to a spectacular and totally unrevealed world.
title: Paradis de rouille

overview: Sophie Haas, an aspiring criminal investigator from Cologne, is relegated to a very small police outpost in the Eifel mountains.
title: Mord mit Aussicht

overview: When an ultra-elite high school enforces a strict "No Romance" rule that expels anyone caught dating, a student secretly helps her classmates for cash.
title: Chastity High

overview: Elsa, a forensic agent, is propelled in 1994, a few months before her father's murder and takes the opportunity to become her teammate to prevent her death, without ever revealing her true identity.
title: Flashback

overview: 17-year-old Mui Ee has only one goal – become an engineer and get a secure job. Just follow the SOP and everything will be ok…right? Of course not! We're talking teenagers here - first year poly students navigating the perils of teen romance, social media minefields, annoying cliques, late assignments and over-zealous parents. There are no SOPs! A reluctant Mui Ee is soon pulled into the web of teen drama involving herself, her friends and the hottest boy in poly. To make things worse, Mui Ee has to babysit her dad as he tries to turn the book, "The Teenage Textbook " into a modern-day app for teens. With all the drama swirling around, Mui Ee has to eventually confront her greatest fear – if she deviates from the set path, will she make an irreversible decision she'll regret for the rest of her life? Mui Ee thinks she knows the answer to that, and part of the fun is finding out if she's right!
title: Teenage Textbook: The Series

overview: Get your Glasto fix with a selection of performances from the festival in 2024.
title: Glastonbury Highlights

overview: Nickelodeon UK & Ireland is inviting viewers to Play Like a Sponge this summer in a brand-new short-form series in which SpongeBob has assembled a team of kids to try a selection of Paralympic sports and meet real life Paralympic legends. Produced in partnership with ParalympicsGB, Play Like a Sponge will inspire kids to find their inner SpongeBob SquarePants as the Nickelodeon icon cheers them on in their quest to learn about and sample new sports with paralympic athletes ahead of the upcoming Paralympic games in Paris this August.
title: Play Like a Sponge

overview: At 48, Tom Villeneuve is finally free. Wrongly accused of murdering his wife, Tom has just spent 17 years in prison. Combative, he studies law in prison and when he is released, he becomes a lawyer. Back in his hometown, Nice, he is determined to find out who the real murderer is. He opens his own practice as a "young" lawyer and defends those he believes to be unjustly accused of crime, like him.
title: Carpe Diem

overview: Officer Gabriel Saint-Barthélémy isn't your average detective. Growing up in a resort on a Caribbean island, he knows both the bright and the dark side of paradise. Saint Barts is a chameleon-like inspector, very good at putting himself in his victims' shoes. And when it comes to solving cases on this paradisiacal Caribbean Island frequented by VIPs, being a Very Intrusive Policeman proves to be particularly effective.
title: Commandant Saint-Barth

overview: Ich bin ein Star, holt mich hier raus! is a reality show originally from the United Kingdom. Ten to eleven public figures, mostly celebrities who have not appeared for a long time, and so-called B-celebrities, live for two weeks in a so-called jungle camp in Australia, similar to the Big Brother format, under constant observation. The title of the program wrongly suggests that the show participants want to escape from the alleged jungle as quickly as possible, but actually refers to the "cry for help" with which the celebrities can refuse to take part in the jungle tests or even get out of the program directly.
title: Ich bin ein Star - Holt mich hier raus!

overview: A legend of Israeli intelligence, Zeev Abadi, is urgently recalled to track down the traitor who stole highly dangerous software developed in utmost secrecy by Unit 8200, a branch of the Israeli Army, and used in Paris for the first time. This mission leads him to collaborate with a French counter-terrorism officer, Fleur Giroud, tasked with solving a strange disappearance that occurred in broad daylight at Charles de Gaulle Airport... From Tel Aviv to Paris, two high-stakes investigations are led by two strong-willed agents. They have 72 hours to unravel this mystery, which is in fact one and the same case. Seventy-two hours of investigation made all the more intense by the bond the duo had forged in the past.
title: Menace Imminente

overview: Certified Teacher Trainer Nicholas Hankins brings the never-before-seen paintings that Bob Ross was preparing for the studio before he passed away.
title: The Joy of Painting with Nicholas Hankins: Bob Ross' Unfinished Season

overview: After inheriting a hefty debt, an ex-special ops officer — now guarding a shopping mall — spots an opportunity to solve his financial predicament.
title: Idź Przodem, Bracie

overview: Follow the once-mighty King Saul as he falls victim to his own pride. A prophet prepares to overthrow him — anointing the outcast shepherd boy David as a second king. As Saul's fury grows, David navigates love, violence and politics in the court of the very man he's destined to replace. Two kings. One Kingdom. The outcome is war.
title: House of David

overview: The Chicken Sisters is a family drama dipped in southern charm and served up with a saucy side of romance. The setting is the fictional town of Merinac, where a generations-old rift between dueling fried chicken restaurants – Mimi's and Frannie's – has left the founders' families fractured and the locals taking sides. When popular cooking competition show Kitchen Clash comes to town, this could be the recipe for ending this feud once and for all. But things are fixing to heat up both inside and outside of the kitchen as the reality show spotlight causes sparks to fly as secrets are spilled and feathers get ruffled.
title: The Chicken Sisters

overview: In this programme we ask one simple question: can you tell the difference between the brand and the own brands, and which do you prefer? Own brands used to carry a stigma. They were bland, boring and came in plain packaging. But now they have upped their game and are taking on the brands head on. The packaging often looks similar, and the names can be very cheeky. But when you strip it all back, can the taste match that of the brand? Some people refer to them as knock offs, others call them dupes… they are the supermarket own brands.
title: Supermarket Own-Brands: The Big Taste Test

overview: Unique access to compelling, never-before-broadcast firsthand accounts of alleged UFO close encounters and alien abductions in the UK.
title: UFO Encounters UK

overview: After rigorous cultivation, humans can ascend to become gods. Above gods are immortals, and above immortals are emperors. Jiang Feng, after a thousand years of hard cultivation, finally ascended to become the Nine Extremes Immortal Emperor. Once mortals broke through the realm of the Immortal Emperor, they could tear through the rift of space and time to defy fate. Determined to rectify all his past regrets, Jiang Feng decided to return to the mortal world. However, upon his return, he discovered that his benefactor, Master Liu, had been poisoned and was in critical condition; his wife, Liu Chenfei, the most beautiful woman in Jiangcheng, was being forced into remarriage; and the entire Jiang family of 138 members had been massacred. At this moment, Jiang Feng unsheathed his Tiangang Sword, which had been sealed for a thousand years.
title: From God to Husband
Tang Ren Jie Tan An Zhi Qing Nian Zhen Tan Tuan
